name: How does cross-examination challenge the prosecution’s case?

mainEntity.name: How does cross-examination challenge the prosecution’s case?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cross-examination exposes inconsistencies, bias, and weaknesses in the prosecution’s witness testimony, which can undermine the reliability of evidence.heathhydelawyer​
